caption: Each step bumps exactly one field and resets the fields to its right to 0, giving 2.4.1 → 2.5.0 → 2.5.1 → 3.0.0. The blue cell is the field that changes; the grey cells are reset to 0.

spec.title: MAJOR . MINOR . PATCH, read left to right
spec.aria: Four versions read down as MAJOR, MINOR, PATCH: 2.4.1 now, 2.5.0 after a backward-compatible feature, 2.5.1 after a backward-compatible bug fix, and 3.0.0 after a breaking API change.
